title: 487. Third Maximum Number

examples.explanation: Distinct values sorted are 3, 2, 1; the third is 1.
Only two distinct values exist, so the maximum 2 is returned.
Distinct values are 3, 2, 1; duplicates do not create extra ranks.

hints: Rank distinct values only; repeats never advance the rank.
Track the top three distinct values in one pass.
If a third distinct value never appears, answer the overall maximum.
